product_card_selector_note: Stable data attribute: [data-component-type="s-search-result"], no walking up parents needed
extraction_note: Name in 'h2 span', price in '.a-price .a-offscreen' (the accessible-text price, cleaner than the visible split price)
gotchas: No login required to read prices, unlike Blinkit
Results can include off-topic items sharing the search keyword (e.g. brand named 'MILK MONEY')
